Name: Farmageddon
Author: MaxMakesMods
Description: This mod adds senseless and useless gore to the game. You can now "kill" any NPC, including any villager. It has absolutely zero consequences in the game, NPCs are just temporarily invisible and a bit of blood splatters around. I just hacked this together in an hour to distract myself from a creative block while working on my DeepWoods mod. It might cause bugs, and I won't fix any that get reported. In fact, you really shouldn't install this at all.

Downloads.Description: For SDV 1.5 Requires SMAPI 3.8.0+ Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.

Manifest.Name: Farmageddon
Manifest.Description: Makes all NPCs in the game killable. Adds utterly over-the-top and senseless gore and violence. Killing NPCs has absolutely no effect on the game aside from killed NPCs temporarily disappear.
Manifest.Author: Max Vollmer
